انتهكوا (form VIII)
# اِنْتَهَكُوا (intahakū) /in.ta.ha.kuː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِنْتَهَكَ (intahaka)
# اُنْتُهِكُوا (untuhikū) /un.tu.hi.kuː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِنْتَهَكَ (intahaka)
# اِنْتَهِكُوا (intahikū) /in.ta.hi.kuː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِنْتَهَكَ (intahaka)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
